def price_tag_2dp(cents):
    """At the corner bakery, Marisol hand-letters every price tag before the
    morning rush, and she has asked you to automate the little labels her
    register prints. Each item's price arrives as a whole number of cents,
    and the tag needs to read in the familiar dollars-and-cents style.
    Return exactly the string '$<d>.<cc>' for the non-negative int cents:
    <d> is cents // 100 with no leading zeros (0 stays 0) and <cc> is
    cents % 100 padded to exactly 2 digits. That is the whole job — one
    tidy tag per price, ready to sit in the display case beside the
    croissants.

    >>> price_tag_2dp(0)
    '$0.00'
    >>> price_tag_2dp(5)
    '$0.05'
    """
